page.notes: Uncertain readings: "cutiatur" at the head is a fragment; the first letters are read from a broken line. The verse reference "i.Tim.i.v.5.6." is copied as printed, with the 5 possibly a long-s form. "eâdē" is read with a tilde over the e and is uncertain. The Greek accents are uncertain on several words. The "I" marker in the margin is read as a section sign and merged into one note. The catchword is absent. Heavy page-edge damage on the left.
